brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net semi-idle game based on being a manorial bailiff (but in a cozy way)
Day-based, no progression limit, point in time, money, whatever stored in the PDS, semi-random scenario generation per-run and per-day (using predefined elements), and citizen sleeper 2 style dice skill checks
note: bailiwick: a cozy semi-idle bailiff game — each morning deals dice, you spend them on village matters with Citizen Sleeper-style skill checks. Manor, cast and days are seeded; saved to your PDS.
